Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a distinct mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side). This pattern is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion (or pyothorax/hydropneumothorax as suggested by the history), which exerts mass effect and pushes mediastinal structures contralaterally, whereas lung collapse or atelectasis would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity.
